newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - New Providence, N.J.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - New Providence, N.J.

text.p: Book Entry Only Bonds, Bank Qualified, Callable
SEALED PROPOSALS will be received by the Chief Financial
Officer of the Borough at the Municipal Center, 360 Elkwood
until 11:00 a.m. for the purchase of the above Bonds of the Borough dated April 1, 1997 and due (subject to prior
$4,620,000 General Improvement Bonds maturing in the principal amount of $300,000 in each of the years 1998 to 2012, inclusive, and $120,000 in the year 2013.

The Bonds will be issued in book-entry form only, in the form of one certificate for the aggregate principal amount of the Bonds maturing in each year. The Bonds are redeemable at the option of the Borough in accordance with the terms set forth in the full Notice of Sale. The Borough will furnish Bonds and the approving legal opinion of McManimon & Scotland, Newark, N.J.

The Bonds will bear interest at a single rate of interest in a multiple of 1/8 or 1/20 of 1% per annum specified by the successful bidder payable semiannually on April 1 and October 1 in each year until maturity, commencing on April 1, 1998. The Bonds will be sold to the bidder specifying the lowest rate of interest in accordance with the terms set forth in the full Notice of Sale.
The full Notice of Sale, the Official Statement and bid forms are available by contacting Richard O. Burr, the Chief Financial Officer at the above address or at (908) 665-1400.
